name: Daydream Club: Thermal Hypnosis
description: You encounter a strange Fontainian in Natlan...

steps.description: Give the Candlecap Mushroom or Embercore Flower to Grispan
Give the Candlecap Mushroom or Embercore Flower to Grispan

dialogs.content: So this is... an Embercore Flower. Not bad, not bad at all. It'll come in handy, I'm sure.
Meow, meow?
My dear President, I fear this flower isn't amenable to being cultivated in Fontaine.
But if you insist, perhaps we could use it as a bookmark?
Meow, meow-meow-meow, meow-meow-meow, meow.
No worries, President. I will keep the introductions short... Ah, you must forgive my mouth for prattling on and on. I do not have another to discipline it with, after all.
#Simply put, {NICKNAME}, I would like you to help me collect objects that contain "phlogiston."
Let me think... Um, so I've been using Candlecap Mushrooms for phlogiston extraction, so, could I get you to help me find some?
That said, I've heard that Embercore Flowers also contain lots of phlogiston... It'd be nice if you could get me one as well!
So long as I have enough phlogiston, I can start my research right here.
Let's go together, shall we?
Together, you say? Even better! I've been champing at the bit to do some fieldwork. And with you here, the risks involved may as well be null and void.
#Come then, let us go. Ah, yes. {M#Mr.} {F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}?
#Then, Madame President... You stay right here. Do not worry! With {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME} here, my personal safety is guaranteed!
Meow... meow meow... meow...
Err, I almost forgot to say that I've marked a certain location on your map. The Candlecap Mushrooms there will more than do!
My, oh my, you are most famous indeed! An honor to meet you both at last!
Meow, meow-meow.
And Madame President bids you good day also. Had we met in Petrichor, I would have gladly treated you to a lovely cup of tea.
But at the moment... Well, let's just say there's not even any tea to be had.
Err, did you run into any trouble? You're pouring with sweat...
Quite understandable. Natlan is pretty hot.
Haha! A gladsome meeting this is! You are the first, and only, person I've met here who shares my sense of humor.
Yet Natlan's heat cannot compare to my inner anxiety. That all my troubles should have struck at once...
Not only have I not gathered enough phlogiston, but I have even lost contact with my hometown.
#I know it is rude to commission someone to do a task after meeting them for the first time, dear {NICKNAME}.
But I do need someone I can rely on — and you are, without a doubt, the best candidate I could ask to find in that regard.
Meow... meow meow... meow...
Oh! This is it! The Candlecap Mushroom. H—How wonderful!
Meow, meow... meow, meow?
Do not fret, Madame President, I shall not be eating any of this... Not until we are done here, anyway.
Well, this place sure is a hot spot... How are you feeling, my good President?
Meow.
Alas, I am sorry. I fear Este and Mécantre have yet to reply in writing.
I wonder what has befallen the town... and yet, I cannot simply pack up and go back now...
You don't look like you're from around here.
And I could say the same to you. Greetings. Grispan's the name, of meager Fontaine Daydream Club fame.
And this is our club President... or would "Director" be more appropriate? Either way, this is our leader, Lady Grobel.
#Hi, I'm {NICKNAME}.
#My thanks for the helping hand, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}.
Ah, this was a thrilling adventure, wasn't it? A good thing I convinced the President to remain with the tribe.
With how much she hates such unexpected incidents, I should hate to be on the receiving end of one of her scoldings.
Still, considering that I still managed to scrounge up sufficient materials... All's well that ends well, hmm?
#These are for you, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME} — thanks again for your help.
Once my research succeeds, I'd be happy to have you be the first to experience "thermal hypnosis."
This is Paimon.
Ha! Take a look at this Grainfruit! It sure is growing well... Might it, too, be affected by phlogiston? I must pick it! It shall join my samples.
#{M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, would you mind helping me out? Just take the stem and...
Look out behind you!
Ah!? H—Help!
Let go of that! Over here!
Are you a member of the Daydream Club?
Eh? Wait, didn't we hear Este and the others talk about someone named "Grispan"?
You've been to our Club? Oh sweet springs of Lucine, some luck at last!
Do you know what's happened over there, by any chance? I've sent letter after letter, yet received no response!
About what happened in Petrichor...
You update Grispan on what befell Petrichor in his absence...
Oh... Wow, uh... That truly is... quite shocking.
Meow... Meow meow. Meow.
Indeed, Madame President. I am truly most shooketh.
I can't believe it! I missed out on a mass hypnosis of such a colossal scale! By the sweet waters of Lucine!
Had I been there, I'd have been able to collect a whole bunch of useful experimental data!
Madame President, it seems that we must finish up here as soon as is humanly possible, so that we may head back to the Club to check on things.
#Ahem... Now, then, I know it is rude to commission someone to do a task after meeting them for the first time, dear {NICKNAME}...
But I do need someone I can rely on — and you are, without a doubt, the best candidate I could ask to find in that regard.
#Ah, my good {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}. We meet again.
Thanks to your help previously, my research has advanced by a leap and a bound.
At this rate, I shall be able to reach my intended targets!
And what were those intended targets?
Oh, I didn't introduce my work to you? Ah, goodness, would you believe that? Come then, let me give you a quick rundown...
Meow! Meow-meow-meow-meow. Meow-meow!
Ah, right you are, Madame President. I shall make this as brief as I can.
Simply put, I am planning to collect phlogiston, and use its "thermal energy" to conduct hypnosis.
My hypnotic device is not on hand at the moment... But, if you would, imagine a box half a person in height, just large enough for a person to sit within.
This box contains a steamer that, well, constantly generates steam, keeping the box's internal temperature at a specified value.
The person undergoing hypnosis will sit within with their head exposed while their body is heated up inside... I believe that this will allow the hypnosis to work faster and better!
That's just going to knock the person out with the heat!
Well, you do have a point, but we perhaps have different definitions of "knocking a person out"...
In any case, let us put aside the finer details for now. At the moment, I still need your help.
The task is the same as before. I'd like you to help me collect objects that contain "phlogiston."
Let me think... Hmm, I'd say you should bring some Embercore Flowers. Those plants certainly do contain a significant amount of phlogiston.
Of course, Candlecap Mushrooms remain important as experimental material. You see...
What do you need from me this time?
Ah, very sharp! I knew that you'd be easy to work with.
Both species will do, right?
How much have you gathered already?
Me? Hahaha... We've gotten off to a "fine" start, that's for sure.
*sigh* But there's nothing I can do about that. The Saurians swarming the wilds of Natlan are generally not the conversational types.
Now, I can handle deactivating machines remotely, and can disable ones that have gone haywire... But there's nothing I can do about Saurians!
Meow meow. Meow...
There are other adventurers in Natlan, you know.
I... Ah, I mean no offense, but I really am not good at dealing with the good ladies and gentlemen of Natlan.
Their enthusiasm would know no shame even if compared to a volcano, but alas, I fear I should be vaporized on the spot should I get too close...
#So you are the only one I can count on, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}!
Meow meow. Meow...
Alright, leave it to me.
Alright then, leave it to me.
I'll do it for Garcia.
Wonderful! I shall be counting on you, then! In the meantime, I shall be here perfecting my phlogiston extraction plan. There are yet many instruments that await my redesigning, too.
Yet, it shall all be worth it! As long as I extract what it is I desire, I can finally return to my hometown and continue researching in peace.
Many thanks! Once my research succeeds, I'd be happy to have you be the first to experience "thermal hypnosis."
Meow! Meow meow, meow!
What do you mean, Madame President? My thermal hypnosis is perfectly safe! No side effects at all!
#Now then, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME} — my good night's sleep and burning phlogiston are in your capable hands.
Let's go together, shall we?
Of course. A couple of things did go wrong in our previous field study, but I learned a lot from it all the same.
Meow, meow...
#Um... Then you stay right here, Madame President. Do not worry! With {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME} here, my personal safety is guaranteed!
Meow... meow meow... meow...
Have you found what I need?
#Now, we have enough material to restart the experiments. Thank you once again, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}.
Please, take this as compensation for your help.
Meow, meow meow, meow.
Our dear President thanks you as well. Once my research succeeds, I'd be willing to engrave your name upon the first thermal hypnosis device.
Alright, then! It's time for some practical tests. Now, where should we conduct those...
